senses.en: something that can be heard
to seem when heard
in good condition, or sensible

ex.en: I heard a sound in the hall.
ex.zh: 我听见大厅里有声音。

ex.en: The sound of night traffic keeps students awake even when the classroom itself is quiet.
ex.zh: 夜间交通的声音会让学生睡不着，即使教室本身很安静。

tip: sound 作连系动词后接形容词：sound good，不接 well 表示“听起来好”（身体好除外）。

senses.en: a wish to know more, or an advantage
to make someone want to know more

ex.en: She has an interest in local history.
ex.zh: 她对本地历史有兴趣。

ex.en: A company interest in cheap land is not the same as a town interest in clean water.
ex.zh: 公司对廉价土地的利益，不等于城镇对干净水的利益。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: to ask for money; to accuse
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: no longer alive

ex.en: The plant is dead because nobody watered it.
ex.zh: 这棵植物死了，因为没人浇水。

ex.en: A river that looks dead in summer may recover if factories stop pouring waste at night.
ex.zh: 夏天看起来死气沉沉的河，如果工厂停止夜里排污，仍可能恢复。

tip: dead 是形容词；die 是动词；death 是名词。

senses.en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend
not generous, or unkind

ex.en: What does this word mean in the passage?
ex.zh: 这个词在文章里是什么意思？

ex.en: A low score does not mean a student cannot learn; it may mean the test ignored what they can do.
ex.zh: 低分并不意味着学生学不会；它可能意味着考试忽略了他们会做的事。

tip: mean to do 是打算；mean doing 是意味着。

senses.en: images during sleep, or a strong hope

ex.en: Her dream is to study medicine.
ex.zh: 她的梦想是学医。

ex.en: A school that only praises high scores can make a quieter dream look less serious than it is.
ex.zh: 只夸奖高分的学校，会让一个较安静的梦想显得不够重要。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream 作动词是“做梦”或“梦想”，后常接 of doing。

senses.en: the smallest unit of a living thing, or a small room

ex.en: We drew a plant cell in biology.
ex.zh: 我们在生物课上画了植物细胞。

ex.en: A biology lesson on the cell is clearer when students can compare it with a room in a building.
ex.zh: 如果学生能把细胞和楼里的一个房间相比，这一课会更清楚。

tip: cell 在生物课是细胞，在监狱语境是单人牢房。手机是 cell phone。

senses.en: happening at even times, or usual

ex.en: She takes a regular bus at seven.
ex.zh: 她七点坐固定的一班公交。

ex.en: Regular sleep helps attention more than one long night of revision.
ex.zh: 规律的睡眠比考前熬一个长夜更有助于注意力。

tip: regular 的副词是 regularly。

senses.en: of the Pacific Ocean

ex.en: The map colours the Pacific in blue.
ex.zh: 地图把太平洋涂成蓝色。

ex.en: A lesson about the Pacific should name the coasts, not only the water.
ex.zh: 关于太平洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。

tip: Pacific 作海洋名要大写。作形容词“和平的”时可以小写，本条用考纲里的太平洋义。

senses.en: to make something not closed, or to start a business
not closed, or public

ex.en: Open the window if the room feels hot.
ex.zh: 如果房间闷，就把窗户打开。

ex.en: Shops that open late help workers who cannot buy food before their shift ends.
ex.zh: 营业到很晚的商店，帮助那些下班前买不到食物的工人。

tip: open 作形容词是“开着的”；be open 表示状态，不要说 be opened 表示日常开着。

senses.en: in or of the south

ex.en: The southern gate is closer to the bus stop.
ex.zh: 南门离公交站更近。

ex.en: Southern cities face long summers, so school timetables may start earlier in the day.
ex.zh: 南方城市夏天很长，所以课程表可能把课排得更早。

tip: southern 是形容词。名词用 south。

senses.en: to get something wanted or useful
something gained

ex.en: She hopes to gain experience in the library.
ex.zh: 她希望在图书馆获得经验。

ex.en: A city can gain parks and still lose old trees if the plan only counts new ones.
ex.zh: 如果方案只计算新种的树，一座城市可以新增公园，同时失去老树。

tip: gain 强调经过努力得到。也可作名词“收益”。

senses.en: matching the facts

ex.en: Is it true that the museum is free today?
ex.zh: 博物馆今天免费，这是真的吗？

ex.en: A story can sound true and still leave out the people who were harmed.
ex.zh: 一个故事可以听起来真实，却仍然漏掉受到伤害的人。

tip: come true 的主语是梦想或预言，不用被动。true 强调符合事实。

senses.en: a system or a set for watching broadcasts

ex.en: They watched the match on television.
ex.zh: 他们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: Television can show a distant classroom, and it still cannot ask the student a question.
ex.zh: 电视可以展示一间遥远的教室，它仍然不能向学生提问。

tip: television 是全称，TV 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from grain

ex.en: The school fair does not sell beer.
ex.zh: 学校义卖不卖啤酒。

ex.en: A town festival that offers beer should also offer a clear rule for students under age.
ex.zh: 提供啤酒的城镇节日，也应当给未成年学生一条清楚的规定。

col: a glass of beer｜一杯啤酒
tip: beer 作种类时可数：a beer。学校场景里它是成人饮料，不是给学生的奖品。

senses.en: to be present at, or to look after

ex.en: All students attend the morning meeting.
ex.zh: 所有学生参加晨会。

ex.en: Students who cannot attend still need the notes the same day.
ex.zh: 不能出席的学生，当天仍然需要笔记。

tip: attend 后直接接活动，不加 to 表示出席。attend to 才是处理或照料。

senses.en: related to the skills of a particular subject

ex.en: The manual is too technical for the first week.
ex.zh: 这份说明书对第一周来说太技术化了。

ex.en: A technical fault in the exam system should not be recorded as a student mistake.
ex.zh: 考试系统的技术故障不应当记成学生的错误。

tip: technical 是形容词。名词技术常用 technology 或 technique。

senses.en: the act of sharing information

ex.en: Clear communication saved the trip.
ex.zh: 清楚的沟通救了这次出行。

ex.en: Communication between the school and the bus company should not depend on one phone.
ex.zh: 学校和公交公司之间的沟通不应当只靠一部电话。

tip: communication 通常不可数。a communication 可指一封正式函件。

senses.en: an agreement, or an amount
to handle, or to do business

ex.en: We made a deal to share the cleaning.
ex.zh: 我们说好轮流打扫。

ex.en: A great deal of plastic leaves a school every day if the canteen still uses single-use boxes.
ex.zh: 如果食堂仍用一次性盒子，学校每天都会送出大量塑料。

tip: a great deal of 后接不可数名词。deal with 表示处理。

senses.en: a way of doing something

ex.en: The bus is our only means of getting to the museum.
ex.zh: 公交是我们去博物馆的唯一办法。

ex.en: A means of checking news matters when a false photo can travel faster than a correction.
ex.zh: 当一张假照片比更正传得更快时，核对新闻的方法就很重要。

tip: means 单复数同形。a means 是一种方法，谓语用单数。

senses.en: the act of going in, or one item in a list

ex.en: Entry is free for students.
ex.zh: 学生免费入场。

ex.en: The last entry in the log should say who locked the lab.
ex.zh: 记录的最后一条应当写明谁锁了实验室。

tip: 动词进入是 enter，已在本库。entry 也可指参赛作品或词典的词条。

senses.en: for everyone, or known to people in general
people in general

ex.en: The public library is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆周日开放。

ex.en: Public money should be easy to trace, from the tax office to the classroom it is meant to support.
ex.zh: 公共资金应该易于追踪，从税务部门一直到它本应支持的教室。

tip: the public 表示公众，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: studying again, or a report judging something
to study again, or to judge

ex.en: We did a review of last week's words.
ex.zh: 我们复习了上周的单词。

ex.en: A review of a new road should include the people who walk it, not only the engineers.
ex.zh: 对新路的评议应该包括走这条路的人，而不只是工程师。

tip: review 作动词是“复习”或“评论”。

senses.en: soldiers as a group

ex.en: The history text mentions troops only as part of the war.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到部队，只是把它当作战争的一部分。

ex.en: News about troops should name the place and the date, not invent a method.
ex.zh: 关于部队的新闻应当写地点和日期，而不是编造方法。

tip: troops 是复数。单数一名士兵不用 troop 来指人，troop 常指一队。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: to need, or to demand

ex.en: The form requires a parent signature.
ex.zh: 这张表需要家长签字。

ex.en: A lab rule that requires goggles protects eyes, and it only works if the goggles are actually there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定能保护眼睛，但前提是护目镜真的在那儿。

col: require sb to do｜要求某人做
tip: require 后接名词或 sb to do。不说 require to do。

senses.en: a large business company

ex.en: The corporation funds the school library.
ex.zh: 这家公司资助学校图书馆。

ex.en: A corporation that uses the school name in an ad should say so on the poster.
ex.zh: 在广告里使用校名的公司，应当在海报上写明。

tip: corporation 比 firm 更常指大公司。可数。

senses.en: a way of thinking or feeling

ex.en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
ex.zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: to be likely to, or to look after

ex.en: Prices tend to rise in a dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的月份价格往往会上涨。

ex.en: Nurses tend the clinic, and the school still needs a number on the wall.
ex.zh: 护士照料医务室，学校仍然需要把电话写在墙上。

tip: tend to do 表示倾向。照料用 tend somebody 或 tend to somebody。

senses.en: a place for drinks, or a long piece

ex.en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽边有一条肥皂。

ex.en: A snack bar at the school gate shapes what students eat more than a poster does.
ex.zh: 校门口的小吃店对学生吃什么的影响，大于一张海报。

tip: bar 的意思靠搭配区分：酒吧、条状物或栏杆。

senses.en: the act of choosing, or what is chosen

ex.en: You have a choice of two questions.
ex.zh: 你可以在两道题里选。

ex.en: A real choice of school exists only when a family can reach it by bus or on foot.
ex.zh: 只有当家庭能乘公交或步行到达时，择校才是真正的选择。

tip: choice 是名词；choose 是动词。

senses.en: to come back, or to give something back
the act of coming back

ex.en: Please return the book by Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前还书。

ex.en: Young people return to a town when there is work, not only when they miss their family.
ex.zh: 年轻人回到城镇是因为有工作，而不只是因为想念家人。

tip: return 本身含“回”，不要说 return back。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anyone can borrow books with a library card.
ex.zh: 任何人有借书证都可以借书。

ex.en: Anyone planning a new road should ask the people who will walk beside it every day.
ex.zh: 任何计划修新路的人，都应该问问每天要在路边走的人。

tip: anyone 作主语时谓语用单数。疑问句和否定句比 someone 更常见。

senses.en: in a correct or suitable way

ex.en: Close the window properly.
ex.zh: 把窗户关严。

ex.en: A notice is useful only if the time is written properly.
ex.zh: 只有时间写对了，通知才有用。

tip: 形容词 proper 已在本库。properly 是它的副词。

senses.en: very pleasing to see or hear

ex.en: The lake looks beautiful in the morning.
ex.zh: 湖在早晨看起来很美。

ex.en: A beautiful old street can still be unsafe if cars park across the pavement.
ex.zh: 一条美丽的老街，如果汽车停满人行道，仍然可能不安全。

tip: beautiful 可形容人、景色或声音。

senses.en: a name that identifies a product

ex.en: The brand on the bag is not a reason to buy it.
ex.zh: 包上的品牌不是购买的理由。

ex.en: A famous brand can raise the price of a simple pencil far above its cost.
ex.zh: 名牌可以把一支普通铅笔的价格抬到成本之上很多。

tip: brand 是商业品牌。作动词可以是“打上烙印”。

senses.en: a feeling of shock, or an unexpected event
to make someone feel surprise

ex.en: The result was a surprise to the whole class.
ex.zh: 这个结果让全班都感到意外。

ex.en: A pleasant surprise still needs a plan if it changes the bus home.
ex.zh: 如果一件惊喜会改变回家的公交，它仍然需要安排。

col: to one surprise｜令某人吃惊的是
tip: surprised 形容人，surprising 形容事物。

senses.en: a situation, a legal matter, or a container

ex.en: In this case, we should ask the teacher.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该问老师。

ex.en: In the case of a city flood, the first question is which roads still lead to the hospital.
ex.zh: 如果城市内涝，第一个问题是哪些路仍然通向医院。

tip: in case 后接句子，表示以防万一；in case of 后接名词。

senses.en: the warmest season

ex.en: The sports meet is in early summer.
ex.zh: 运动会在初夏举行。

ex.en: A hotter summer makes classrooms without fans harder places to learn.
ex.zh: 更热的夏天让没有风扇的教室更难学习。

tip: 季节前常用 in，不加 the：in summer。

senses.en: a number of people or things together

ex.en: Our group will present first.
ex.zh: 我们组第一个展示。

ex.en: A small group of volunteers can keep a community library open when the town budget is thin.
ex.zh: 当城镇预算紧张时，一小群志愿者也能维持社区图书馆开放。

tip: a group of 加复数名词时，谓语可随强调整体或成员而变化。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group

ex.en: She is a member of the science club.
ex.zh: 她是科学社团的成员。

ex.en: Every member of a team should know who will speak if the plan fails.
ex.zh: 团队的每个成员都应该知道，如果计划失败由谁来说明。

tip: member 后常用 of，不用 in。

senses.en: an idea that explains facts

ex.en: The theory is simple, but the test is not.
ex.zh: 理论很简单，但实验并不简单。

ex.en: A theory about climate is useful only when students can see the measurements behind it.
ex.zh: 关于气候的理论，只有当学生能看到背后的测量数据时才有用。

tip: in theory 常和 in practice 对照。表里这一行的音标其实是 theoretical，本库改用 espeak。

senses.en: an animal that lives in water
to try to catch fish

ex.en: The fish in this lake are protected.
ex.zh: 这个湖里的鱼受保护。

ex.en: If a river has no fish, the birds that feed on them leave the town as well.
ex.zh: 如果河里没有鱼，以鱼为食的鸟也会离开这座城镇。

tip: fish 单复数同形。表示一条鱼可用 a fish。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: Her daughter studies at this school.
ex.zh: 她的女儿在这所学校上学。

ex.en: A daughter who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女儿，应该看到有女性在做这份工作。

tip: daughter 的复数是 daughters。

senses.en: during the time that, or whereas
a period of time

ex.en: I listened to the recording while I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时听了录音。

ex.en: Some cities invest in stadiums while their oldest school buildings still leak in the rain.
ex.zh: 一些城市投资体育场，而它们最老的校舍下雨时仍在漏水。

tip: while 可表示对比，相当于“而”；一段时间用 for a while。

senses.en: a place where children are educated

ex.en: Our school has a new science lab.
ex.zh: 我们学校有一间新的科学实验室。

ex.en: A school that stays open in the evening can give working parents a safe place for their children.
ex.zh: 晚上仍然开放的学校，可以为上班的父母提供一个孩子的安全去处。

tip: go to school 泛指上学，school 前通常不加 the。

senses.en: to lift, to increase, or to care for a child

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: Towns that raise bus fares should also say how students on free meals will travel.
ex.zh: 提高公交票价的城镇，也应当说明吃免费餐的学生怎么出行。

tip: raise 是及物动词。不及物的“上升”用 rise，已在本库。

senses.en: to put, arrange, or establish
a group of things that belong together

ex.en: Please set the chairs in a circle.
ex.zh: 请把椅子摆成一圈。

ex.en: If a school sets homework without time to sleep, the extra pages may lower the next day's attention.
ex.zh: 如果学校布置的作业挤掉了睡眠，多出来的页数可能会降低第二天的注意力。

tip: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set。a set of 后接复数名词。

senses.en: to give food

ex.en: Who will feed the cat during the holiday?
ex.zh: 假期谁来喂猫？

ex.en: A canteen that can feed every student still needs a quiet table for those who eat slowly.
ex.zh: 能让每个学生吃上饭的食堂，仍然需要一张给吃得慢的人的安静桌子。

tip: feed 的过去式和过去分词是 fed。feed on 表示以……为食。

senses.en: school lessons in sport and exercise

ex.en: Physical education is on Tuesday afternoon.
ex.zh: 体育课在周二下午。

ex.en: Physical education needs a safe yard, not only a mark on the report.
ex.zh: 体育需要一个安全的场地，而不只是成绩单上的一个分数。

tip: 常缩写为 PE。形容词 physical 已在本库，本条保留全称，因为考纲里单独出现。

senses.en: clear and exact

ex.en: Please give a specific example.
ex.zh: 请给一个具体的例子。

ex.en: A specific date for opening the clinic matters more than a general promise.
ex.zh: 诊所开业的具体日期，比笼统的承诺更重要。

tip: specific 强调明确；special 强调特别。

senses.en: at all times

ex.en: She always checks her answers twice.
ex.zh: 她总是把答案检查两遍。

ex.en: Towns that always build on the cheapest land may later discover that the ground floods.
ex.zh: 总在最便宜的土地上建设的城镇，日后可能会发现那块地会积水。

tip: always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: the sky, or a place of complete happiness in some religions

ex.en: The poem looks up at heaven.
ex.zh: 这首诗望向天空。

ex.en: Good heavens is an old phrase of surprise, not a fact about the sky.
ex.zh: Good heavens 是表示惊讶的旧说法，不是关于天空的事实。

tip: heaven 在宗教里常指天堂。文学里也可指天空。

senses.en: past events, or the study of them

ex.en: We have a history test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有历史测验。

ex.en: Local history is easier to care about when students can visit the street the textbook describes.
ex.zh: 当学生能去教科书描写的那条街时，本地历史就更容易让人在意。

tip: history 作学科不可数。historical 是“历史的”；historic 常指有历史意义的。

senses.en: not including

ex.en: Everyone was present except Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都到了。

ex.en: The museum is free except on the one day when a special show raises the price.
ex.zh: 除了特别展览涨价的那一天，博物馆都是免费的。

tip: except 表示排除；besides 表示除此之外还有。

senses.en: newly made or picked, or clean and new

ex.en: The canteen has fresh fruit on Monday.
ex.zh: 食堂周一有新鲜水果。

ex.en: Fresh air in a classroom depends on windows that actually open, not only on a poster.
ex.zh: 教室里的新鲜空气取决于窗户真的能开，而不只是一张海报。

tip: fresh water 是淡水，不是“刚接的水”这一个意思。

senses.en: a workers' organisation, or a joining together

ex.en: The union asked for safer night buses.
ex.zh: 工会要求更安全的夜班公交。

ex.en: A union of small shops can buy together and keep a market alive.
ex.zh: 小店的联合可以一起进货，并让市场继续活着。

tip: the European Union 是欧洲联盟。

senses.en: whether a person is male or female

ex.en: The form asks for your name and sex.
ex.zh: 表格要填写姓名和性别。

ex.en: A school sports rule based only on sex can be unfair if it ignores what each student can actually do.
ex.zh: 只按性别制定的学校体育规则，如果忽略每个学生实际能做什么，就可能不公平。

tip: sex 在考纲里主要作“性别”，填写表格时用。

senses.en: a result
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: a senior university teacher

ex.en: The professor answered questions after the talk.
ex.zh: 教授在讲座后回答了问题。

ex.en: A visiting professor can show students how research looks outside their own textbook.
ex.zh: 客座教授能让学生看到研究在自己课本之外是什么样。

tip: professor 是大学里的高级职称，中学老师一般称 teacher。

senses.en: holding one's attention

ex.en: The talk was interesting.
ex.zh: 讲座很有趣。

ex.en: An interesting museum is still out of reach if the bus fare is too high.
ex.zh: 如果公交票价太高，有趣的博物馆仍然到不了。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: very great, or very far in one direction

ex.en: The extreme heat closed the afternoon sport.
ex.zh: 极端高温让下午的体育停了。

ex.en: Extreme views in a debate still have to answer the same question: what happens to the bus?
ex.zh: 辩论里的极端观点，仍然必须回答同一个问题：公交怎么办？

tip: extreme 作名词可指极端。go to extremes 是走极端。

senses.en: help
to help

ex.en: The clinic keeps a first-aid box by the door.
ex.zh: 医务室在门边放着急救箱。

ex.en: Food aid after a flood helps for a week; repairing the road helps for years.
ex.zh: 洪水后的食品援助能帮上一周，修路则能帮上很多年。

tip: aid 作动词是帮助，比 help 正式。

senses.en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface

ex.en: This area of the library is for quiet study.
ex.zh: 图书馆这一区是安静学习用的。

ex.en: Industrial areas beside rivers need stricter rules, because waste travels farther than the factory gate.
ex.zh: 河边的工业区需要更严的规定，因为废物会流到比厂门更远的地方。

tip: area 可指地区或面积，面积不可数时仍说 an area of。

senses.en: to become better or make something better

ex.en: Reading aloud can improve your pronunciation.
ex.zh: 朗读能改进你的发音。

ex.en: Towns improve a bus line by counting who is left at the stop, not only who is already on board.
ex.zh: 城镇改进公交线路，要数还留在车站的人，而不只是已经上车的人。

tip: improve 可及物也可不及物：improve English；English improves。

senses.en: firm and hard, or reliable
a substance that is not a liquid or a gas

ex.en: Ice is solid water.
ex.zh: 冰是固态的水。

ex.en: A solid plan names who locks the door, not only what the poster says.
ex.zh: 扎实的计划会写明谁锁门，而不只是海报上的话。

tip: solid 作名词是固体。

senses.en: to ask formally; to use
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: She will apply for a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她将申请奖学金。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: not dirty
to make something not dirty

ex.en: The lab must be clean before we leave.
ex.zh: 离开前实验室必须干净。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is a public duty, not a luxury for one neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 干净的饮用水是公共责任，不是一个社区的奢侈。

tip: clean 作动词是“打扫”。

senses.en: happening at once
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: She got an instant reply.
ex.zh: 她得到了立即回复。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

senses.en: a final decision or end
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
ex.zh: 报告的结论很清楚。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: trade, a company, or a matter to deal with

ex.en: Her aunt runs a small business near the station.
ex.zh: 她阿姨在车站附近做小生意。

ex.en: A business that ignores its waste may save money this year and lose the trust of the town next year.
ex.zh: 忽视废弃物的企业今年也许省了钱，明年却可能失去城镇的信任。

col: none of one's business｜不关某人的事
tip: business 表示生意时可不可数；表示一家企业时可数。

senses.en: the way people or things are connected

ex.en: The relationship between the two clubs is friendly.
ex.zh: 两个社团的关系很友好。

ex.en: The relationship between rent and bus fares decides whether a worker can live near a job.
ex.zh: 房租和公交费之间的关系，决定工人能否住在工作附近。

tip: relationship 比 relation 更常指人与人的关系。

senses.en: added to

ex.en: Two plus three is five.
ex.zh: 二加三等于五。

ex.en: A low fare plus a late bus is still a poor service for students.
ex.zh: 低票价加上晚点的公交，对学生来说仍是糟糕的服务。

tip: plus 可作介词或名词。A plus B。

senses.en: to put things into a bag or box
a bag, or a group

ex.en: Pack your bag the night before the trip.
ex.zh: 出行前一晚把包打好。

ex.en: Students who pack only what the list says leave room for a coat.
ex.zh: 只按清单打包的学生，还能给外套留出地方。

tip: pack 作名词是包，或一群。a pack of 后可接物或动物。

senses.en: very bad weather with wind and rain

ex.en: The storm started after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后暴风雨开始了。

ex.en: A storm plan should say who calls parents if the buses stop.
ex.zh: 风暴方案应当写明公交停运时谁给家长打电话。

tip: storm 可数。a storm of protest 比喻一阵抗议。

senses.en: what a person or thing is called
to give a name, or to say a name

ex.en: Please write your name in capital letters.
ex.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

ex.en: A place can lose its old name when new maps care more about roads than about the people who named it.
ex.zh: 当新地图更在意道路而不是命名的人时，一个地方可能失去旧名。

tip: name 作动词是“命名”：name the baby。

senses.en: a place where aircraft land and take off

ex.en: The airport bus leaves every half hour.
ex.zh: 机场大巴每半小时一班。

ex.en: An airport far from the city helps flights, and it also makes the last bus home matter.
ex.zh: 远离城区的机场方便航班，也让末班回家的车变得重要。

tip: airport 是一个词，不要拆开写。

senses.en: a part of the coast where the land curves in

ex.en: The town sits on a quiet bay.
ex.zh: 小镇坐落在一个安静的海湾边。

ex.en: A bay that looks calm can still be a poor place for a school boat on a windy day.
ex.zh: 看起来平静的海湾，在有风的日子仍可能不适合学校的小船。

tip: bay 是海湾，比 gulf 小。

senses.en: many times

ex.en: I often review new words on the bus.
ex.zh: 我经常在公交上复习生词。

ex.en: Streets that often flood need a better drain, not only a warning after the rain starts.
ex.zh: 经常积水的街道需要更好的排水，而不只是雨开始后的警报。

tip: often 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: a country with an elected head, not a king

ex.en: The text compares a republic with a kingdom.
ex.zh: 课文把共和国和王国作了比较。

ex.en: A republic still has to decide who may vote and who may go to school.
ex.zh: 共和国仍然必须决定谁可以投票、谁可以上学。

col: the People's Republic of China｜中华人民共和国
tip: republic 可数。People's Republic 要大写。

senses.en: a person who leads a meeting or an organization

ex.en: The chairman asked each class to speak once.
ex.zh: 主席请每个班发言一次。

ex.en: A chairman who keeps the clock also keeps the last speaker from being pushed out.
ex.zh: 守时的主席也能避免最后一位发言人被挤掉。

tip: 复数是 chairmen。现在也常用 chair 或 chairperson 表示同一职务。

senses.en: the unit of money in the US and some other countries

ex.en: The book costs ten dollars.
ex.zh: 这本书十美元。

ex.en: A dollar sign on a school poster should not be the only way a family learns the real cost.
ex.zh: 学校海报上的美元符号，不应当是家庭得知真实费用的唯一方式。

tip: 符号是 $。100 cents 等于 1 dollar。cent 已在本库。

senses.en: a purpose or goal
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: Our aim is to finish on time.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: the people who work for an organisation

ex.en: The staff meeting is at four.
ex.zh: 职员会议在四点。

ex.en: Hospital staff on the night shift need a bus after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班的医院职工需要一趟在常规班次停运之后的公交。

tip: staff 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: a very young child

ex.en: The baby slept through the whole meeting.
ex.zh: 婴儿在整个会议期间都睡着。

ex.en: A baby clinic once a month is not enough for a village that is two hours from the hospital.
ex.zh: 对离医院两小时的村子来说，每月一次的婴儿诊所是不够的。

tip: baby 的复数是 babies。

senses.en: large and impressive, or important

ex.en: The grand hall can hold the whole school.
ex.zh: 这个宏伟的大厅能容纳全校。

ex.en: A grand opening means little if the new library still has no books for the lower grades.
ex.zh: 如果新图书馆仍然没有适合低年级的书，盛大的开幕就意义不大。

tip: grand 也可放在称呼里，如 grandfather。

senses.en: the clear liquid we drink
to pour water on plants

ex.en: Please bring your own water to the sports meet.
ex.zh: 运动会请自带水。

ex.en: When a city wastes water in dry months, farms downstream have less for the next planting season.
ex.zh: 城市在干旱月份浪费水，下游农场下一季可种的水就更少。

tip: water 通常不可数，不说 a water。

senses.en: one of two equal parts
equal to one of two parts

ex.en: Half of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 班上一半的人步行上学。

ex.en: Cutting a journey by half still leaves some students on the bus for more than an hour.
ex.zh: 把路程缩短一半，仍有一些学生要在公交上坐一个多小时。

tip: half of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数；half an hour 中间有 an。

senses.en: American spelling of colour

ex.en: What color is your bag?
ex.zh: 你的包是什么颜色？

ex.en: The color of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe to touch.
ex.zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否可以安全触碰。

tip: color 是美式拼写；英式是 colour。考纲里两种都可能出现。

senses.en: ill, or about to vomit

ex.en: He stayed home because he felt sick.
ex.zh: 他觉得不舒服，所以待在家里。

ex.en: A sick child sent to school can pass an illness through a whole class by noon.
ex.zh: 带病上学的孩子，到中午就可能把病传给全班。

tip: be sick of 表示厌烦，不是生病。英式 feel sick 常指恶心。

senses.en: able to harm you

ex.en: The icy steps are dangerous.
ex.zh: 结冰的台阶很危险。

ex.en: A dangerous crossing near a school is a planning problem, not only a warning to children.
ex.zh: 学校附近危险的路口是规划问题，而不只是对孩子的一句警告。

tip: dangerous 形容事物。处于危险中的人用 in danger。

senses.en: not bent or curved
directly

ex.en: Draw a straight line under the title.
ex.zh: 在标题下画一条直线。

ex.en: A straight road through a wetland may be faster for cars and worse for the water.
ex.zh: 穿过湿地的直路对汽车可能更快，对水却更糟。

tip: straight 可作形容词或副词，不要写成 straightly。

senses.en: to move forward, or to help something develop
progress, or money paid before the work

ex.en: The line will advance when the gate opens.
ex.zh: 门开后队伍会向前走。

ex.en: Science can advance and still leave a village without clean water.
ex.zh: 科学可以进步，村子却仍然可能没有干净的水。

tip: in advance 表示事先。advance 作名词是进展或预付。

senses.en: the state of being free from control

ex.en: The country marks independence in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月纪念独立。

ex.en: Independence in study means a student can start without waiting to be told every step.
ex.zh: 学习上的独立，是指学生不必每一步都被吩咐也能开始。

tip: 形容词 independent 已在本库。Independence Day 要大写。

senses.en: buying and selling, or a kind of work
to buy and sell

ex.en: The town lives by trade with the city.
ex.zh: 这个城镇靠与城市的贸易过活。

ex.en: Fair trade in food means the farmer, not only the shop, receives a living wage.
ex.zh: 公平的食品贸易意味着农民而不只是商店获得足以生活的工资。

tip: trade 作动词是“交易”。

senses.en: belonging to the place where you were born
a person born in a place

ex.en: She is a native speaker of the local dialect.
ex.zh: 她的母语是当地方言。

ex.en: Native plants along the path need less water than a lawn that must stay green.
ex.zh: 路边的本地植物比必须保持翠绿的草坪更省水。

tip: native 作名词是本地人。用在人身上时要注意礼貌，不要带轻视。

senses.en: a piece of information sent to someone

ex.en: I left a message on her desk.
ex.zh: 我在她桌上留了口信。

ex.en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is under water.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路被水淹之前到达才有帮助。

tip: message 是可数名词。

senses.en: the salt water covering much of the earth

ex.en: We could smell the sea from the hill.
ex.zh: 我们在山上能闻到海的气味。

ex.en: Plastic that reaches the sea started as packaging someone dropped in a town.
ex.zh: 进入大海的塑料，起初是有人在城镇里丢掉的包装。

tip: by sea 表示经海路，不加 the。go to the sea 常指去海边。

senses.en: a building where people are kept as a legal punishment

ex.en: The history text describes the old prison.
ex.zh: 历史课文描述了那座旧监狱。

ex.en: A town that builds a prison still has to decide what happens to a person on the day they leave.
ex.zh: 建造监狱的城镇，仍要决定一个人出狱那天会发生什么。

tip: in prison 表示服刑，通常不加 the。

senses.en: having many parts
A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
ex.zh: 问题比看上去更复杂。

ex.en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。

tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

senses.en: how hot or cold something is

ex.en: The temperature in the lab is too high.
ex.zh: 实验室温度太高。

ex.en: A city that records temperature near schools can see which classrooms need shade.
ex.zh: 记录学校附近温度的城市，能看出哪些教室需要遮阴。

tip: temperature 可数。have a temperature 常指发烧。
